crossRefs.note: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men will take hold, out of all the languages of the nations, they will take…

translations.web: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”
translations.bsb: and said, “Surely we will return with you to your people.”
translations.kjv: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.
translations.asv: And they said unto her, Nay, but we will return with thee unto thy people.
